move.trigger: when a claim rests on an assumption the reader shares

move.quote: The usual story is that the queue is slow. It is not the queue.

cases.text:
Everyone says the queue is slow. That assumption is wrong.

The lock on the writer is held across the network call, so every consumer waits on one socket. Release the lock before the call.
cases.note: the gesture is there (a challenge) and the move's point (why the assumption misleads) is not; MISSING is also defensible, since the move as described was not made. Soft on the two.

cases.text:
Everyone on the team blamed the queue, because the queue is the only thing they can see in the dashboard. The queue is a symptom: it fills because the writer holds a lock across the network call, so every consumer waits on one socket.

Release the lock before the call.
